definitions.CAUSE_REVERSAL: Reverse the direction of an established causal relation.
definitions.SCOPE_EXPANSION: Apply a claim to a broader population, setting or period than supported.
definitions.SCOPE_REDUCTION: Narrow the supported scope so that the original claim changes.
definitions.CLAIM_STRENGTHENING: Increase certainty or magnitude beyond the evidence.
definitions.CLAIM_WEAKENING: Reduce a supported claim so its meaning changes.
definitions.CONTRAST_LOSS: Remove a comparison or contrast necessary to interpret the claim.
definitions.CONDITION_LOSS: Remove a condition on which the claim depends.
definitions.ADDED_CAUSALITY: Turn association or sequence into an unsupported causal claim.
definitions.UNSUPPORTED_DETAIL: Add a factual detail that the source evidence does not support.
definitions.KEY_DETAIL_OMISSION: Omit information necessary to retain the core claim.
definitions.COMPARISON_REVERSAL: Reverse the ordering or roles of compared groups; this is not necessarily causal.
definitions.DENOMINATOR_CHANGE: Change the population counted by a proportion or rate.
definitions.MEASUREMENT_TIME_CHANGE: Change or conflate the age, time or sequence of measurements.
definitions.RESULT_DIRECTION_CHANGE: Change an increase, decrease or null result into a different direction.
